name: Ralys Stone
source:
Ralys is famous for his defeat of the current darkness that threatened the peace. He is given the title of hero, a title rarely given to an individual.

He is one of the few who has acquired skills new in the modern age.

Specialty: Guns

[From [url=http://unbrokenhours.com/ruin/characters/ralys/]official site[/url]]
